characters.summary: Aberforth Dumbledore is a formidable wizard and proprietor of the Hog's Head Inn, proficient in defensive and protective magic such as the Patronus Charm. He fights using standard wand-based dueling techniques.

sources.supports: Aberforth Dumbledore's magical abilities, Patronus Charm, and involvement in the Battle of Hogwarts.

feats.claim: Cast a powerful goat Patronus to ward off Dementors.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

feats.claim: Fought in the Battle of Hogwarts against Death Eaters.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Defeated multiple Death Eaters during the Battle of Hogwarts.

campaignTags.claim: Aberforth is a fully trained wizard capable of casting complex spells such as the Patronus Charm.

unknowns: Extent of his duel capability compared to his brother Albus remains largely unshown.

characters.summary: Alastor 'Mad-Eye' Moody is a veteran Auror and expert duelist equipped with specialized magical artifacts like his Magical Eye. He relies on extensive combat experience, stealth detection, and powerful curses.

mechanisms: Magical eye providing 360-degree vision and perception through invisibility cloaks

weaknesses: Physical impairments due to injuries sustained in his career as an Auror
limitations: Limited physical mobility due to a wooden leg and missing eye.

sources.supports: Alastor Moody's status as an Auror, his Magical Eye, and his combat proficiency.

feats.claim: Captured numerous dark wizards single-handedly, filling the Azkaban cells.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

feats.claim: Detected Harry Potter beneath the Invisibility Cloak using his Magical Eye.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
notableResults.note: Fought in multiple skirmishes against Voldemort's followers.

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
notableResults.note: Amushed and overpowered prior to the events of the tournament.

campaignTags.claim: Master wizard and veteran Auror capable of casting high-level magic.

unknowns: Exact details of many of his historical Auror captures are unrecorded.

characters.summary: Albus Dumbledore is widely regarded as one of the most powerful wizards of all time, specializing in transfiguration, elemental fire magic, and complex charms. He fights with supreme tactical control and vast magical power.
weaknesses: Cursed hand resulting from the ring of Marvolo Gaunt
Emotional vulnerabilities regarding Grindelwald and family
limitations: Stamina limited in later years by the curse in his hand.

sources.supports: Albus Dumbledore's magical capabilities, dueling history, and spells.

feats.claim: Dueled Lord Voldemort to a standstill in the Ministry of Magic Atrium.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

feats.claim: Subdued numerous Death Eaters and animated the Ministry statues for defense.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
notableResults.note: Fought evenly in the Ministry of Magic until Voldemort possessed Harry.

notableResults.citation: Historical lore referenced in Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

campaignTags.claim: Master wizard capable of immense and complex magical feats.
Conjured and manipulated massive rings of enchanted fire during duels.

characters.summary: Amelia Bones was the Head of the Department of Magical Law Enforcement, highly skilled in complex defensive and offensive magic as demonstrated during her final resistance.

sources.supports: Amelia Bones' career as Head of DMLE and her skilled resistance against Voldemort.

feats.claim: Put up a fierce resistance resulting in a difficult battle before being overcome by Lord Voldemort.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
notableResults.note: Killed after putting up a reportedly ferocious fight.

campaignTags.claim: Highly accomplished witch and Head of Magical Law Enforcement.

unknowns: Specific spells cast during her final battle are not detailed in text.

characters.summary: Aragog is a giant, sentient Acromantula capable of human speech and commanding swarms of lesser spiders. He attacks using physical size, venom, and sheer numbers of offspring.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to bright lights and fire
Impaired mobility due to advanced age and blindness in later years
limitations: Old age significantly reduced his physical agility and hunting capability.

sources.supports: Aragog's physical traits, Acromantula abilities, and colony leadership.

feats.claim: Bred and commanded a massive colony of sentient spiders in the Forbidden Forest.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets

campaignTags.claim: Aragog is an exceptionally large Acromantula, the size of a small elephant.

unknowns: Exact potency of his venom compared to younger Acromantulas.

characters.summary: Argus Filch is the non-magical (Squib) caretaker of Hogwarts. He relies on institutional authority, trap setting, and his cat Mrs. Norris for surveillance rather than combat magic.

sources.supports: Argus Filch's status as a Squib and caretaker of Hogwarts.

feats.claim: Patrolled the corridors of Hogwarts enforcing school rules for decades.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone

unknowns: Any combat capacity beyond basic physical restraint.

characters.summary: Arthur Weasley is a Ministry wizard specializing in Muggle artifacts and protective enchantments. He fights with standard defensive and offensive spells when necessary.
weaknesses: Fascination with Muggles can distract him in combat situations
limitations: Not a frontline combat specialist by trade.

sources.supports: Arthur Weasley's employment at the Ministry and magical capabilities.

feats.claim: Fought in skirmishes protecting the Order of the Phoenix.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
notableResults.note: Ambushed and severely injured by Nagini at the Department of Mysteries.

campaignTags.claim: Qualified wizard capable of defensive and offensive spellcasting.

unknowns: Full capability in high-level dueling outside of standard Ministry requirements.

characters.summary: Barty Crouch Jr. is an exceptionally talented and fanatical Death Eater skilled in advanced dark arts, transfiguration, and long-term impersonation via Polyjuice Potion.
weaknesses: Fanatical devotion to Voldemort can lead to overconfidence
limitations: Requires constant supply of Polyjuice Potion for sustained impersonation.

sources.supports: Barty Crouch Jr.'s magical skill, use of dark arts, and role as Moody impostor.

feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

feats.claim: Cast the Dark Mark into the sky at the Quidditch World Cup.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
notableResults.note: Achieved victory through ambush and assistance.

campaignTags.claim: Proficient dark wizard capable of casting complex and forbidden curses.

characters.summary: The Basilisk is a massive legendary serpent possessing lethal venom and a gaze that causes instant death to anyone who looks into its eyes directly. It fights using physical constriction, crushing weight, and deadly natural attributes.

mechanisms: Impenetrable scale hide resistant to standard spells

weaknesses: Vulnerable to the crowing of a rooster
Susceptible to physical damage from extremely potent magical weapons (e.g., Sword of Gryffindor)
limitations: Lacks ranged offensive projections beyond its line-of-sight gaze.

sources.supports: Basilisk physiological traits, deadly gaze, venom, and vulnerability to the Sword of Gryffindor.

feats.claim: Killed victims instantly via eye contact and destroyed magical defenses with its fangs.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
notableResults.note: Slain by Harry Potter using the Sword of Gryffindor after being blinded by Fawkes.

campaignTags.claim: The Basilisk is a gargantuan serpent dozens of feet in length.

unknowns: Exact lifespan limit if undisturbed in a subterranean chamber.
